text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 890 College Street, Delaware Avenue flankage.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 890 College Street, Delaware Avenue flankage, with the following conditions: a. The Licensee shall ensure the maximum number of seating on the patio is 45. b. The Licensee shall not provide or permit music on the outdoor patio. c. The Licensee shall ensure all doors and windows are closed while live music or amplified music is played inside the establishment. d. The Licensee shall ensure a noise and visual barrier is installed at the north end of the patio. e. The Licensee shall undergo a review of the permit and conditions in Two (2) years by the local Councillor. f. The Licensee shall close the patio at 11:00 p.m. daily.
